designManifest.visualThesis: A strong carousel returns to its central idea with new evidence on every page.
designManifest.semanticMetaphor: A red thread that bends, gathers observations, and returns changed.
designManifest.rhythmPlan: Open with an image, compress into structure, pause on one sentence, then resolve with a practical loop.
compositionIntent: Let the returning line carry the idea before the reader begins to explain it.
Turn the visual metaphor into a clear four-stage working system.
Remove most structure so the central judgment can breathe.
Reconnect image, method, and human review in one final loop.
designManifest.contrastPlan: Use the first and third pages as visual pauses around denser explanatory pages.
designManifest.typeStrategy: Serif display claims with quiet sans-serif operational labels.
designManifest.whyThisVisual: The content is about iteration, so a returning physical line expresses the mechanism more directly than another diagram.
designManifest.imageCadence: Image-led opening, structural explanation, quiet typographic pause, then mixed resolution.
